name: Wake ~Futari dake no Himitsu~
source:
Hero has to transfer from a boys' city school to a mixed town private school due to his father job circumstances. He's appointed responsible for the festival preparation and all his team members are beautiful girls. Thus the spring of his life begins. 

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/10/vn-of-month-february-1999.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
由于父亲工作的原因，主人公必须从男子城市学校转学到混合制城镇私立学校。他被任命负责筹备校庆，所有组员都是美丽女孩。于是，他的青春开始了。

[来源：[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/10/vn-of-month-february-1999.html]vndbreview[/url]]
